title: Open Decisions lock + Pipeline fixes + Agents C+D completion

dependencies.reason: Wave 4 first pipeline run must be committed (change_manifest_session_23.json status=COMPLETED) before pipeline fixes begin

critical_notes: Agents C+D for all 3 plugins must run BEFORE session 24 begins (cron job scheduled at 03:35 AM Apr 5 to retry). Verify reports/backwpup-agent-c.json and reports/backwpup-agent-d.json exist before starting pipeline fixes.

DI-23-01 fix (merge path mismatch): merge_agent_outputs.py writes to reports/<slug>-phase2.json but gate reads from reports/phase2/<slug>-phase2.json. Fix: update merge_agent_outputs.py default output path to reports/phase2/ OR add --output-path flag. Max 5 lines.

DI-23-02 fix (apply_review upgrade guard): phase3_apply_review.py 'upgrade' branch has 'f.get("verdict") in ("REVIEW", "FP")' guard that blocks upgrades when phase2 verdict is already TP. Fix: remove or widen the guard so that UNCERTAIN gate findings can have their validation_status promoted. Must also update gate validation_status not just phase2 verdict.

DI-23-03 assessment: Determine whether benchmark/compare.py should read from phase3 gate JSON (validation_status) instead of phase2 (verdict). This is an architectural decision — document rationale in change_manifest_session_24.json. Do NOT change benchmark without user approval.

Open Decisions to lock (from IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md:190-191): (3) Claude Code verify depth top-3 vs top-5 — lock based on Wave 4 results; (4) Agent prompts reuse phase2 vs write new — already decided: SKILL SETs are new prompts (sessions 20-21), decision is 'write new'.
If agents C+D have NOT run by session start → defer pipeline fixes and focus on Open Decisions lock only. Do NOT block on quota.
E1 applies: source_ref wins. E5 applies: do not expand scope beyond the 4 gap IDs listed.

DI-23-01.change: Update default output path so merged phase2 JSON is written directly to reports/phase2/<slug>-phase2.json. This eliminates the manual cp step required after every merge. If adding --output-path flag is cleaner, do that instead.
DI-23-01.note: Max ~5 lines change. If spec here conflicts with source_ref → source_ref wins.

DI-23-02.change: Fix 'upgrade' branch: remove or widen the 'f.get("verdict") in ("REVIEW", "FP")' pre-check so that LLM upgrade recommendations apply even when phase2 verdict is already TP. The goal is to update gate validation_status (UNCERTAIN → PLAUSIBLE) not just phase2 verdict. May require reading phase3 gate JSON alongside phase2 — check if layout.phase3 gate file is accessible in apply_review.py context.
DI-23-02.note: This is a non-trivial change — ensure gate re-run (subprocess.check_call to phase3_gate.py) still happens after applying edits. If change exceeds 10 lines, document plan and defer to its own session.

DI-23-03.file: benchmark/compare.py (assessment only, no code change without user approval)
DI-23-03.change: Read benchmark/compare.py and document: (1) what field it reads to determine TP/FP (phase2 verdict or phase3 gate validation_status?); (2) whether this is correct given the pipeline design; (3) recommendation. Do not change benchmark.py without user approval — document decision in change_manifest.
DI-23-03.note: Assessment only. The benchmark definition (what counts as TP) is a research decision, not a code fix.

OPEN-DECISIONS.change: Lock decisions #3 and #4: (3) Claude Code verify depth — based on Wave 4 results and S5 skill set design, lock at top-3 (balance between coverage and context budget); (4) Agent prompts reuse vs new — already answered by sessions 20-21: SKILL SETs are new purpose-built prompts (not reused phase2 prompts). Update Open Decisions table in IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md with locked answers and rationale.
OPEN-DECISIONS.note: If IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md is inconsistent with what sessions 20-21 implemented → source_ref (IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md:190-191) determines what 'TBD' means, but the actual implementation in skill-set-verify.md and skill-set-agent-a.md determines the locked answer.

WAVE4-AGENTS-CD.change: After agents C+D run (cron job or manual): (1) re-merge all 3 plugins using merge_agent_outputs.py --agents 'reports/<slug>-agent-*.json'; (2) copy merged file to reports/phase2/ (or use DI-23-01 fix); (3) re-run phase3 gate for each plugin; (4) run LLM review for new uncertain findings; (5) run benchmark/compare.py --all; (6) update wave_4_results.json with final complete data.
WAVE4-AGENTS-CD.note: This spec requires agents C+D to exist before execution. If quota still blocked, defer to session 25.
